transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I came in because I’ve been feeling like certain things aren’t just coincidences. Like one of my MBA classmates and a startup advisor are sort of… coordinating opportunities for me quietly. Comments in class, Slack messages — they feel coded, like signals about where my career is supposed to go. I know that probably sounds strange.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or intensely energized lately?

Yeah… kind of. Most days I’ve felt really switched on, like something big is about to happen and I’m supposed to be ready for it. It’s mostly optimistic, but I’ve also been getting irritated fast — snapping at my team or my boyfriend over little delays that normally wouldn’t bother me.
Have you been needing much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
I don’t know… I haven’t really been tracking it. Maybe a little less than usual, but I’m not sure.
Have you been hearing voices when no one is there?

Sometimes, yeah. Not like a full conversation… but a few times a week, usually when I’m up late working, I’ll hear my name or something short, like “go now.” It’s clear enough that I check my phone or look around, but no one’s there.
Have there been times when you heard those voices or felt people were sending you coded messages even when your mood was not unusually high or irritable?

No… I don’t think so. Before this whole stretch of feeling so wired and driven, that kind of thing wasn’t happening. The coded messages and hearing my name started after my mood shifted and I got really intense with the MBA prerequisites.
Has there been a time when you were hearing voices or felt people were sending you coded messages while your mood felt completely normal?
No… not that I can remember. Before I got this energized and wrapped up in the MBA stuff, I wasn’t hearing my name or thinking messages were coded. That only started after things shifted.
